# Webgram IT Solution

> Webgram IT Solution is a Delhi NCR web development company (founded by Vikas Kumar; GST registered and working with clients since 2022; Sangam Vihar, New Delhi) building ecommerce websites, B2B commerce platforms, WooCommerce and Shopify stores, marketplaces and custom web portals for businesses in India and abroad.

Contact: +91 7551120242, info@webgramitsolution.com. GSTIN 07CUHPK2017G1ZW. Hours Monday to Saturday, 10:00 to 19:00 IST. Pricing is quoted per project after a requirement call; there is no fixed public price list.

## Services

- [Ecommerce Development](https://webgramitsolution.com/solutions/ecommerce-development): Online stores with WooCommerce or Shopify, payments, shipping and SEO.
- [B2B Commerce](https://webgramitsolution.com/solutions/b2b-commerce): Wholesale portals with customer pricing, MOQ, RFQ and ERP-ready integrations.
- [Website Design](https://webgramitsolution.com/services/website-design): Business websites designed for enquiries and search.
- [WooCommerce Development](https://webgramitsolution.com/services/woocommerce): WordPress-based stores.
- [Shopify Development](https://webgramitsolution.com/services/shopify): Hosted Shopify stores.
- [Web Portal Development](https://webgramitsolution.com/services/web-portal-development): Custom portals and dashboards.
- [Website Maintenance](https://webgramitsolution.com/services/website-maintenance): Updates, security and support.
